Game Overview

In Red Stickman and Blue Stickman, the core idea is straightforward: guide Red Stickman and Blue Stickman through perilous temples, dodging hidden traps and collecting coins. Master dual controls, outsmart thorns, and evade lava to reach color-coded doors. Balance speed and caution in this thrilling arcade test of reflexes and strategy. Can you conquer each challenging level?
